Question: can you draw the new patient process from booking to the exam?

Here is the new patient path at Brightsmile Dental from booking through the first exam.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Book online or by phone] --> B{Insurance on file?}
    B -->|Yes| C[Confirm by text]
    B -->|No| D[Front desk calls for insurance card]
    D --> C
    C --> E[Arrive 15 minutes early]
    E --> F[Complete health history form]
    F --> G[X-rays]
    G --> H[Exam with dentist]
```

The only branch is the insurance check: without insurance on file, the front desk calls you before the booking is confirmed [1]. On the day, forms and X-rays come before the dentist exam [2].

Question: how does ordering a custom cake work? steps please

Ordering a custom cake at Rosewood Bakery follows these steps.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Submit order form 7+ days ahead] --> B[Decorator reviews design]
    B --> C{Complex design?}
    C -->|No| D[Standard price]
    C -->|Yes| E[Custom quote by email]
    D --> F[Pay 50 percent deposit]
    E --> F
    F --> G[Order date locked]
    G --> H[Pick up after 10 am and pay balance]
```

Order at least 7 days ahead [1]; your date is only secured once the 50 percent deposit is paid [2], and the balance is due at pickup after 10 am [2][3].

Question: Draw the process when I call about a plumbing problem.

This is how FlowRight Plumbing handles a call from first contact to the repair.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Customer calls] --> B{Water actively leaking?}
    B -->|Yes| C[Shut off main valve]
    C --> D[Technician dispatched immediately]
    B -->|No| E[Booked in next available slot]
    E --> F[Technician diagnoses]
    D --> F
    F --> G[Written estimate]
    G --> H{Customer approves?}
    H -->|Yes| I[Repair work starts]
    H -->|No| J[Call-out fee only]
```

- Active leaks skip the queue and you are asked to shut off the main valve [1].
- No work begins until you approve the written estimate; declining costs only the call-out fee [2].

Question: what happens if I want to quit the gym?

Cancelling at IronPeak Gym goes like this.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Request cancellation] --> B[Staff offer freeze up to 3 months]
    B --> C{Accept freeze?}
    C -->|Yes| D[Membership frozen]
    C -->|No| E[Submit cancellation form]
    E --> F{Within 12-month commitment?}
    F -->|Yes| G[Pay early termination fee]
    F -->|No| H[30 days notice, no fee]
```

You will be offered a freeze first [2]. If you still cancel, whether you pay a fee depends on whether you are inside your 12-month commitment [1].

Question: process for grooming a dog there the first time?

First-time grooming at Fluffy Tails works like this.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Book online and choose service] --> B[Upload rabies proof]
    B --> C[Appointment confirmed]
    C --> D[Check-in coat check]
```
